column2: [intro]
I put on a smile, so easily fake
Behind my sweet words, hides a mean ego
I play the nice guy, but I'm just a fraud
I hurt those who love me, it's my dark side
I pretend to be someone good
But deep down, I can be so bad
The mask hiding my true feelings
I am the nice guy, but only in appearance
I can hurt with sharp words
Ignoring the consequences, I am so mean
I betray promises, break hearts without remorse
My double face, I wear it like a treasure
I pretend to be someone good
But deep down, I can be so bad
The mask hiding my true feelings
I am the nice guy, but only in appearance
[ solo ]
In the mirror, I no longer recognize myself
The weight of this mask, so heavy and so confusing
I pretend to be loving, but I do the opposite
The nice guy in front, but the jerk in the back
[outro]
